caption: The drawing features two large, ornate metal objects, both of which are brownish-red in color with a weathered appearance and shaped with elaborate curves and pointed tips. Both objects have a long straight section that ends in a circular hole at the base. One is positioned vertically, while the other is tilted diagonally to the right. In the upper right portion of the drawing, there is a simple black outline of a clock face with minute marks and two clock hands indicating the time as approximately 1:59. The background is a plain beige color. There is small, fine text near the lower right side of the image, which includes the signature "WALTER J PRAEKE" and the date "1948."
title: Church Clock Hands
